trap.label: used to + base
trap.wrong: We used to meeting on Fridays.
trap.right: We used to meet on Fridays.
trap.why: Em português “costumávamos nos reunir” leva infinitivo; o brasileiro tende a pôr -ing ou o verbo flexionado. Em inglês, used to + verbo base; nas negativas e perguntas, use to (didn’t use to).

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com used to: “I played every day.” (hábito antigo)
rewrite.answer: I used to play every day.
Did you use to live here?
